idea: "What's Missing?" #3 (THE LIBRARY, story corner, at a small wooden easel): Baby Jimmy's toddler crayon drawing of a SNOWMAN comes alive and wiggles on the paper – but it has NO NOSE ('Oh no! My snowman has no nose!'); 'Two round eyes and a big smile...'; Jimmy points at the empty spot and asks the viewer 'What's missing? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'A nose! A nose! An orange nose!'; 'Magic crayon, draw with me! A carrot nose!' – he draws an orange carrot nose; chorus 'Snowman, snowman! Here's your nose!'; review 'Eyes, a smile and a carrot nose! Yay!'; copy-me 'Wiggle, wiggle, like a snowman! Brrr, brrr! So cold!'. Loop: the hook framing again, the snowman now with its carrot nose, bye-bye wave 'Happy snowman! Bye bye, friends!'.
lesson: Look carefully and spot what is missing: a face has eyes, a mouth (smile) and a nose; a snowman's nose is an orange carrot.
calendar: Saturday slot 1 – "What's Missing?" signature episode #3 (ep.1 kitty tail 30 Oct, ep.2 car wheel 14 Nov). Seasonal: first winter weeks (late November).
place: THE LIBRARY (text-only block, section 4) – story corner with a small wooden easel
characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue short-sleeve onesie with a small yellow star, barefoot.
supporting: THE CRAYON SNOWMAN: a real toddler's crayon drawing of a simple SNOWMAN on white paper – wobbly thick black crayon outlines, two stacked round circles with light blue scribbly crayon shading, two black dot eyes, a curved black smile, black dot buttons, two brown stick arms, a red scribbly scarf, and (only from shot 3 on) an ORANGE carrot-shaped triangle nose; on a small light-wood easel. THE MAGIC CRAYON: a big chunky crayon that glows and changes color, with tiny sparkles around it (orange here).
setting: THE LIBRARY: a quiet colorful children's library with low bookshelves, bean bags and a story corner.

learning.goal: Spot the missing part: the snowman has eyes and a smile but no nose; Jimmy draws an orange carrot nose.
learning.shown_how: Hook/question: the crayon snowman with two dot eyes, a smile and an EMPTY spot in the middle of its face, big beside Jimmy's face; shot 3 the orange Magic Crayon draws the carrot nose there; shots 4-5 the complete snowman with its orange nose.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:06 'What's missing? Hmm?' + 0:07.9-0:09.6 humming-only pause (question boing) -> 0:10 'A nose! A nose! An orange nose!' + cheer
learning.copy_me: wiggle like a snowman (0:22-0:25), shiver 'Brrr, brrr!' (0:25-0:27), wave bye-bye
learning.fact_check: Hook/question/drawing frames: snowman face has two eyes + smile, the nose spot is empty (checked at full size). Shots 4-5 frames: one orange carrot nose. No letters/numbers anywhere (library books have plain covers).
learning.modeling: Jimmy notices a problem calmly and fixes it himself by drawing; no wrong behaviour.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, soft daylight, big clear drawing beside his face, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: the crayon snowman comes alive with no nose
copy-me: wiggle like a snowman, brrr
Magic crayon, draw with me! + loop ending + Bye bye, friends!

story_order.carrot nose: absent shots 1-2 (frames-to-video, same frame first and last), drawn line by line in shot 3 (start frame: crayon tip on the empty spot), present shots 4-5

video_model: viewmax-c1 768P 9:16 8s (2 credits/s = 16 per shot), 5 shots = 80 credits; s1, s2 frames-to-video (first = last frame) to keep the nose absent
image_model: nano-banana-2 2K (8 credits each this run): f0 base with complete snowman; f1 hook = edit of f0 (nose erased + gasp); f2, f3 edits of f1 (first tries rejected: f2 lost buttons, f3 footed pajamas -> r1); f5 loop = edit of f0

song.note: take 1 clean (Gemini flash audio check: no pitched instruments, no drum kit); humming pause 7.9-9.6 s

Jimmy points, tilts his head, questioning
orange carrot nose drawn line by line following the crayon tip
Jimmy and the snowman wiggle side to side, clap
